notes.title: Patch for balancing and bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Some minor bug fixes
- Enemies respond much faster after Orbi's attack
- Some minor balancing fixes
- Added graphics for side and main quests
- Easy mode is now the default difficulty mode
- Timer on Normal mode is now 45 seconds

notes.title: Demo re-activated again and some changes coming up
notes.notes:
Game demo is re-activated again. You can play a portion of the first chapter to familiarize yourself with the game mechanics.
We are also preparing some small changes Like faster response of the enemies and the frequency of some letter appearing on the letter-board.

notes.title: Major developing update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39319889/13e221527a8b96c8a04edfb08afb013b945737df.png
Throughout the development of the game we believe that its design was not exactly as we would have liked. We decided to change the design of the UI a lot and many elements of the gameplay also have been changed.
We want the game to be more complete in terms of both design and gameplay.
We have added many quality of life improvements. An important addition is the use of the keyboard in battles.
The quality of the game has now reached where we would like and as soon as we are ready we will show it to you in a new demo that we will release.
Old screenshots and trailers are going to be removed from the store main page and will be replaced with the new ones we are preparing.
Despite all the changes we have made to the game, we believe that the release date will remain as it is.
November 2021
